evidence_snippets: Limitations A workstation configuration may specify GPUs, subject to the following limitations: Cloud Workstations only supports GPUs for configurations that specify machine types in the N1 machine series , the A2 machine series , or the A3 machine series .

Using Google Cloud Hyperdisk disk types is only supported on these following machine series: A3 C3 C4 G4 M3 N4 N4D Z3 Supported GPU models Cloud Workstations supports many of the GPU models that Compute Engine makes available.
